{"metadata":{"description":"Rust SDK for DSH(Deepseek Harness)","id":"gh:1335713527","install_available":false,"language":"Rust","name":"dsh-rust-sdk","slug":"42ch-dev/dsh-rust-sdk","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-sdk"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Rust SDK for DSH(Deepseek Harness)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# deepseek-harness-sdk"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"See the CHANGELOG for the release history."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Rust client SDK for the DeepSeek Harness
(DSH) runtime. The runtime is the `dsh` CLI booted under a "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"named profile —
this crate spawns it as a subprocess (`dsh --profile sdk`, the profile
default) and "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"speaks its stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol. One crate, two layers:
the high-level Python-parity API (`De"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"epSeekHarness` / `Session::run` /
`RunResult`) and the low-level protocol client (`HarnessClient`)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The crate is the design twin of the official
Python SDK, sharing the
same runtime peer, wire protoco"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"l, and layering; the Python SDK surface is the
alignment baseline for every public type and error. T"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"he TypeScript SDK's
divergences are documented (notably `RunResult`, see below), as are the
crate's "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"own deliberate divergences from both references (see
Deliberate divergences)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"This crate is a **pure client**. It contains no agent, LLM, or persistence
logic — the spawned runti"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"me process does all of that. The runtime is
bring-your-own: this crate never downloads, bundles, or "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ships one (see
Runtime acquisition)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"or in `Cargo.toml`:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Pick the version that suits you (`cargo search deepseek-harness-sdk` or the
crates.io page shows the"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"
latest). While the crate is on a pre-release line, a bare
`cargo add deepseek-harness-sdk` may not "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"resolve to the newest pre-release —
request it explicitly (e.g. `cargo add deepseek-harness-sdk@0.1."},{"id":"p12s4","text":"0-alpha`) when
you want it. The API may still change before `0.1.0`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Two prerequisites before the first run: a DSH runtime (see
Runtime acquisition) and model credential"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s
(`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` in the environment, or `Config::api_key` /
`Config::base_url`)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"A bring-your-own runtime is operator-installed: the npm-published CLI requires
**Node.js `>= 24.9.0`"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"** (its own declaration, `apps/cli/package.json`), while
the platform wheel carries its own Node. Th"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"e crate installs nothing — below
the floor the CLI reports its own engine failure, not a crate error"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" crate installs nothing — below
the floor the CLI reports its own engine failure, not a crate error."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Verified runtime versions"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Each release below was checked two ways: a **keyless handshake** — the crate
spawns the runtime from"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" that install, `DeepSeekHarness::start` completes
`initialize`, and `close` reaps the child, with no"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" API key and no live turn —
and a reading of the **upstream SDK-facing surface** at the release tag."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Runtime (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`) | Status | Verified by |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| `0.2.2-rc.1` | verified | CI keyless handshake; wire and launch contract re-verified at `dsh-v0.2."},{"id":"p18s2","text":"2-rc.1` |
| `0.2.1-rc.5` | verified | keyless handshake; SDK-surface diff at `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5` |
| `"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"0.2.1-rc.4` | verified | keyless handshake; SDK-surface diff at `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.4` |
| `0.2.1-rc.3` |"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" verified | keyless handshake; SDK-surface diff at `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3` |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` | verified | k"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"eyless handshake; SDK-surface diff at `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2` |
| `0.2.1-rc.1` | verified | keyless handsh"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ake; wire and launch contract re-verified at `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.1` |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The crate sends only six methods — `initialize`, `session/prompt`,
`session/resume`, `session/workin"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"g-directory/get`,
`session/working-directory/set`, and `shutdown` — and parses what comes back
toler"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"antly, so an unknown field never fails a response: additive upstream
changes between these releases "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"are expected to pass through unchanged."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Releases outside this table are **unverified**. The pin in
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` names the vers"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ion the handshake job exercises."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Quickstart"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`DeepSeekHarness::start` is eager: it resolves the runtime, resolves (and
creates) the harness home,"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" spawns the subprocess, and completes the
`initialize` handshake before returning. The runtime inher"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"its
`DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` / `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` from the environment, and a
configured `Config::base_ur"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"l` / `Config::api_key` is injected under those
names, so callers can use real model endpoints direct"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ly or point those
variables at a local proxy. Whether the injected value outranks a stored
credentia"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"l is **unverified** — see
Environment variables."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Runtime acquisition"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The runtime is bring-your-own; the SDK only resolves and launches it. There
is **no separate JSON-RP"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"C agent program**: the stdio JSON-RPC server the SDK
talks to is a plugin row inside the runtime's p"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"rofile bundle. The runtime is
the ordinary `dsh` CLI from
deepseek-harness, booted
under the `sdk` p"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"rofile (or any profile you name via `Config::profile`)."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Three routes to a runtime:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Route A — the npm-published CLI (recommended)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The `dsh` CLI is published on npm as `@deepseek-ai/dsh`. A bare
`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` in"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"stalls the `latest` dist-tag, which can
lag behind upstream's newest release; `npm install -g @deeps"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"eek-ai/dsh@alpha`
tracks the newest. This crate's CI verifies the npm route with a keyless
handshake"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" on every pull request, and the exact version under test lives in
`.github/workflows/ci.yml`."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The installed bin is a Node.js script, so **Node.js must be on `PATH`** for
the SDK to launch it. Th"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"e crate spawns the resolved program directly without
a shell, and the npm bin is a Node.js script ra"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ther than a native executable
— on Windows, prefer the self-contained wheel route (Route B)."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Pre-release software** — the crate ships pre-release versions while the
runtime protocol settles"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"; the API may change before `0.1.0`. The
real-runtime tests are environment-gated (see Testing); the"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"
fake-runtime suites carry protocol correctness.
- **No mid-turn cancel** — there is no session-clos"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"e / cancel RPC on the
wire. `Session::run` waits until the root session reports `idle`; closing
the "},{"id":"p32s5","text":"harness mid-turn abandons the in-flight turn. A `Config::request_timeout`
only abandons the local wa"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"it — the server-side work still runs until
close.
- **No version negotiation** — the runtime identif"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"ies as `serverInfo` 0.0.1
pre-release, and `initialize` enforces a strict `serverInfo.name` check
(`"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"deepseek-harness-sdk-runtime`): the protocol declares the name
wire-stable and has no negotiation, s"},{"id":"p32s9","text":"o an unexpected identity is a hard
`Error::SdkProtocol`.
- **No runtime binary delivery / bundling /"},{"id":"p32s10","text":" download** — the runtime
companion crate is a roadmap item, not part of this version. Acquire the
r"},{"id":"p32s11","text":"untime per Runtime acquisition."}],"truncated":true}
